name: navios-memory-reflex
description: Local-first staged graph memory and compaction recovery for Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Retrieve durable local memory and recover after compaction.
interface.longDescription: A local-first Codex memory layer that assimilates project notes into provenance-addressed cells, surveys typed graph relationships before selective hydration, cultivates evidence-only proposals, queues unresolved human-will conflicts without aging out either claim, and restores a frozen checkpoint after compaction.
defaultPrompt: Initialize durable memory for this project
Retrieve relevant memory with exact provenance
Show the current compaction recovery checkpoint
